author: raman118
body:
#### References to other Issues or PRs

Fixes #19324.

#### Brief description of what is fixed or changed

`Symbol('s').copy()` raises `TypeError` because the inherited method reconstructs it from empty arguments. `Atom.copy()` now returns the immutable atom itself, preserving symbol assumptions, dummy identity, wildcard exclusions, and numeric precision. Nonatomic expressions retain their existing shallow-copy behavior.

#### Other comments

The regression reproduced the original `TypeError`. Basic, symbol, and number tests passed (156 tests), along with code-quality tests (6 passed), Ruff, and `bin/mailmap_check.py`.

#### AI Generation Disclosure

OpenAI Codex (GPT-6 Astra) generated all changes in `sympy/core/basic.py` and `sympy/core/tests/test_basic.py`. This PR description was also written by the AI agent at the account owner's request.

#### Release Notes

<!-- BEGIN RELEASE NOTES -->
* core
  * Fixed `.copy()` on symbols and other atoms to return the immutable atom itself instead of failing when reconstructing it from empty arguments.
<!-- END RELEASE NOTES -->

linked.body:
From https://gitter.im/sympy/sympy?at=5ebd78a149cc4a3b62e7a69f (ping @asmeurer):

```python
In [155]: s = Symbol('s')

In [156]: s.copy()
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
TypeError                                 Traceback (most recent call last)
<ipython-input-156-6e1d2ee6d3ad> in <module>
----> 1 s.copy()

c:\users\wiese\repos\ga\sympy\sympy\core\basic.py in copy(self)
    115
    116     def copy(self):
--> 117         return self.func(*self.args)
    118
    119     def __reduce_ex__(self, proto):

TypeError: __new__() missing 1 required positional argument: 'name'
```

This should probably either:
* Actually make a copy (perhaps by setting `self.func = functools.partial(Symbol, name=self.name)`
* Return `self`
* Raise a clearer error message
